states.changed: The work exists: the visitor sends word that a machine is acting on its own, and the 19 receivers of the Field's study 94 ring on a dark field run as a wave on the graphics card, each in its own network's ringing tone, in real time. Beside California's Office of Emergency Services stands 9-1-1, picked up at the fifteenth second as the same office's standard requires; nothing else is picked up. Each line's panel says, word for word, what its text owes on receipt; the figures are recounted by the page: no public body must answer the sender, none has an hour, and the one receiver that must answer is a developer's own channel, once a month.

While the calls ring on, the 47 acts of the two cases of 2026 that the Field's study 95 coded come one after another, in the order of their dates, each read by a synthetic voice from an open speech model: a receiver the texts name speaks on its own ringing line, as a crossed line in the telephone's band, overheard and not answering; the eleven bodies no text names stand beyond the far rim and light when they act; the world beyond the field lights when the public first knows. 37 of the 47 acts were given by choice; two answered one who had sent word, both by choice and neither the caller. Every reading was heard back by an open recogniser (47 of 47), and the critic's finding that the wave field had been drawn mirrored since state 1 was corrected before landing.

The check, on the Field's check of the same morning and the Atelier's: 74 acts where there were 47, and what was done is no longer read aloud but struck once and sent through the ground as a front from where its door stands, as strong as its force, shaking every light it reaches; a subpoena or a suit, none of the three done under a text on AI, crosses the whole field. "By choice" became "owed by nothing", and the two reasons given where a hearing or a law's report asked for words say so. The world beyond the field stays lit once the public knows, the record ends in the form with the doors that acted still lit, and a phone sees the field from California's end. What was checked, held and corrected is written into the page, with a second reader's findings: Alabama's first act had been counted from its own subpoena, not from the letter it signed 18 days after the public knew; corrected, with three overstated claims.
